metadata.scope: Base game through 2.2.0.5 and released Ancient Egypt DLC

confidence_legend.confirmed: direct public source explicitly supports the fact for a released update or visible UI
confidence_legend.candidate: public evidence exists but exact version, identity, or role is not fully reconciled
confidence_legend.unknown: no reliable evidence for the field; null must not be inferred

notes: The Miraheze wiki currently exposes 19 Deck-category pages, six Ancient Egypt deck pages (24 listed cards), 47 Building-category pages, and 138 mainspace pages. No Ra deck page/card list is present in the current API census.
The Steam Egypt scenario checklist and gameplay video confirm Ra is used in a scenario and identify leads, but do not establish Ra card membership or a full deck roster.
The 30-recipe Steam guide is community-authored and its exact game version is not pinned. Its inputs are retained as candidate references, not canonical recipes.
No Amun-Ra entry is supported by the examined sources. Temple of Luxor remains a monument candidate only.
